dimensions.full: Channels a human can reach it through; live voice loop.
Useful work with nobody in the chair, and dead work gets loud.
Can it prove where a fact came from; does history survive updates.
Hybrid search quality, and whether anyone actually benchmarked it.
Packaged capability, kept trustworthy with linting and install gates.
Does it get better on its own, and is that safe.
Is 'the right capability fired and the output was good' measured or vibes.
Fan-out, pipelines, cross-model adjudication, quarantine tiers.
Injection defense, blast-radius control, secrets, supply chain.
Local models, own hardware, no single vendor able to switch it off.
Finance, CRM, legal, client delivery, approval-gated publishing.
Who else improves it while the operator sleeps.
